subject: Exec workshop: notes circulation, action owners, and sprint handoff
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Olivia King <olivia.king@acme.com>, Mike Torres <mike.torres@globex.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Exec workshop: notes circulation, action owners, and sprint handoff

Hi all,

Thanks again for an efficient two days — appreciate the candid product feedback and the scheduling flexibility. Attached are the consolidated meeting notes and the raw action-item tracker we pulled together in the room. Quick summary and asks: 

- Attachments: 20261129-Exec-Workshop-Notes.pdf (conference notes & annotated decisions), slide-deck-final.pptx, action_items_tracker.csv (working tracker).
- Please review the tracker and add or confirm owner names in the "Owner" column by EOD Thursday PST. We want to lock owners before we start the sprint handoff next week.
- Acme: Olivia / Mike — I gave a red highlight to the three asks your team requested (procurement timeline, pilot scope, telemetry export). Can you confirm owner assignments from your side so we can record them in the tracker?
- Logistics: travel expense receipts and on-site reimbursements — Marissa will coordinate exceptions and handoffs; please tag receipts to the tracker row for the related action.
- Recording and collateral: Zoom recording and final deck uploaded to the shared Drive link below. If anything is missing, flag it in the tracker and mark it as "Needs Upload."

Recording & Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3ExecWorkshop
HubSpot: HS-123456

Thanks — I will consolidate owner confirmations into a single tracker snapshot on Friday morning and send a follow-up with a proposed 2-week sprint scope.

Ava Chen
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: 20261129-Exec-Workshop-Notes.pdf (PDF), action_items_tracker.csv (CSV), slide-deck-final.pptx (PPTX)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Olivia King <olivia.king@acme.com>, Mike Torres <mike.torres@globex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec workshop: notes circulation, action owners, and sprint handoff

Thanks Ava — received and skimmed. Couple of operational asks from my side: 

1) Can we enforce these minimal columns in the CSV before we lock: "Owner (redwood or acme)", "Owner Email", "Due Date (ISO)", "Priority (P1/P2/P3)", "Status". I can run a quick script to normalize.
2) For traceability, please paste the HubSpot deal link or ID on the "Related Link" column for any commercial action; similarly create a Jira SUP ticket for any engineering deliverable we commit to. I will seed SUP-4512 for the telemetry export.
3) Suggested cadence: after owners are locked Friday, I propose a 15-min stand on Tuesdays for the first 6 weeks to keep momentum. If Acme prefers a bi-weekly instead, note that in the tracker.

If either Olivia or Mike can drop owners by Wednesday EOD (their timezone), I'll do the normalization pass Thursday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Ava. Acme owners below (per tracker rows):

- Procurement timeline & contract redlines: Olivia King (olivia.king@acme.com) — tentative internal sign-off by 12/10. Attached our internal procurement timeline so you can align dates.
- Pilot scope (data & KPIs): Mike Torres (mike.torres@globex.com) is taking point; he will confirm specific telemetry and KPI definitions by Friday.

We don't need a weekly stand — bi-weekly sync is fine for the first month. If you want me to add attendees from Acme beyond Mike, tell me which roles and I'll add.

We uploaded our procurement questions to the Drive under /Acme/Procurement-Questions and added comments to the slide deck on page 13 and 16.

Thanks everyone — confirming next steps from Redwood side: 

- I will merge Acme owner confirmations into action_items_tracker.csv and normalize columns as Dev requested. Expect a merged snapshot by Thu 09:00 PST.
- I'll create the first bi-weekly invite for Mon/Tue (Acme availability permitting) and mark it optional for some contributors. Please accept or propose alternatives.
- Travel receipts & reimbursements: please upload receipts to the Drive folder and add the receipt URL in the tracker row under "Expense Receipts". For exceptions (e.g., pre-approved hotel nights), mark the row "Finance Review" and I will route to our finance partner.
- Owners locked in the tracker will map to HubSpot HS-123456 and SUP-4512 where relevant; I'll add those links in the "Related Links" column.

I'll send the merged tracker and calendar invites after the normalization pass. If anyone wants the tracker exported as an XLSX for internal use, reply and I will attach it.

Marissa Cole
